dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: Rukh Shah is not only dependable, he's the youngest Parchamdar in Corps history!

dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: Supposedly he's from the rainforest, not the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: You know how rare rainforest people are in the ranks of the Eremites, much less a Parchamdar.

dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: He's very impressive, getting along not only with the desert dwellers, but Akademiya researchers too.

dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: Maybe there's truth to the rumor that he was once a researcher himself.
